label: Read paper summary batch
description: Inspect or prepare a paper or read its remaining source content without a fixed item or output-token cap. Inspect reports reusable source-versioned evidence and its resume cursor. When a source read would exceed the next model request's available context, only the fitting source spans become this batch's coverage; follow next_start AND next_offset exactly to continue without overlap. Read serially and durably append cited evidence before the next read. If uncheckpointed raw content was archived, reread the source batch before claiming its coverage; a cached slice alone does not establish a complete paper read. Continue until has_more=false. Save an explicitly partial summary if work is interrupted with unread coverage; do not treat targeted or incomplete coverage as a full read.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.action: Inspect metadata/readability, prepare unreadable extraction, or read a pages/chunks batch.
parameter_descriptions.start: For pages, the one-based page; for chunks, the zero-based chunk. Follow next_start exactly. Null resumes after existing checkpointed evidence, or starts at the beginning when none exists.
parameter_descriptions.offset: Character continuation within the first page/chunk, from next_offset. Null or 0 starts a fresh item; null with start=null resumes the durable cursor.
